> - Update **README** or relevant docs
> - Add an entry to **CHANGELOG.md** (Keep a Changelog format)
> - Bump versions (plugin header / `style.css` / `package.json` / `composer.json`) in line with **SemVer**
>
> After that we can squash‑merge.
